description: A template of the library gains a `<video>` written in a namespace, `<xH1ml:video>` — a capital and a digit inside a prefix of five, as Angular's lexer takes one — and 1.2.1 keeps resting on the scan. `ngc` makes the same element of a prefixed `video` as of a bare one (measured with `foo:`; the schema takes off every prefix but `svg` and `math`): a video. Read with no prefix, the scan found none.
